name: unchecked-is-not-healthy
why: A signal whose source could not answer is not a signal that came back clean. acme/watched has a reader and reports unhealthy, so it raises a drift row; acme/unwatched has no reader at all, so its health is null and it raises nothing here - the caller reports that gap as unchecked beside the queue rather than letting an absent row pass for a healthy one. The two repos also pin the tie-break: within one signal, rows order by repo and then by number, so a queue over a floor of sixty stays stable between sweeps.

expected.detail: 3 unreleased commit(s); next would cut v2.1.0
